Control Objective: Ensure new users receive approved access based on job responsibilities
Current State: Access requests require manager approval and role assignment
Expected Evidence: Access request form manager approval and provisioning record
Recommended Action: Continue retaining approval and provisioning evidence

Control Objective: Ensure terminated users lose access promptly
Current State: Termination access removal occurs but some disablement evidence is delayed
Expected Evidence: Termination notice account disablement log and timestamp
Recommended Action: Automate offboarding and review termination-to-disablement timing

Control Objective: Ensure user access remains appropriate over time
Current State: Access reviews are performed but approval evidence is incomplete
Expected Evidence: Quarterly access review report reviewer approval and remediation evidence
Recommended Action: Perform complete quarterly reviews and retain approval evidence

Control Objective: Ensure administrator access is limited approved and reviewed
Current State: Privileged accounts exist but recurring review evidence is incomplete
Expected Evidence: Privileged account inventory business justification and reviewer approval
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Control Objective: Reduce conflicting access that could affect financial systems
Current State: Some incompatible permissions are not consistently reviewed
Expected Evidence: SoD matrix conflict report and remediation records
Recommended Action: Perform recurring segregation-of-duties reviews and resolve conflicts

Control Objective: Ensure production changes are formally approved before implementation
Current State: Changes require documented approval before release
Expected Evidence: Change ticket approval record and implementation date
Recommended Action: Continue enforcing approval before production deployment

Control Objective: Ensure system changes are tested before production deployment
Current State: Testing occurs but evidence is not consistently attached to change records
Expected Evidence: Test results screenshots and change ticket documentation
Recommended Action: Require testing evidence before production approval

Control Objective: Ensure production deployments receive authorized approval
Ensure emergency changes are reviewed after implementation
Current State: Emergency changes are documented but post-implementation reviews are inconsistent
Expected Evidence: Emergency change ticket and retrospective approval
Recommended Action: Require post-implementation review for all emergency changes

Control Objective: Ensure critical systems and financial data are backed up
Current State: Backup jobs run regularly and failures are monitored
Expected Evidence: Backup logs monitoring records and backup policy

Control Objective: Ensure backups can be successfully restored
Current State: Backups exist but restoration tests are not performed consistently
Expected Evidence: Restore test report recovery logs and test results
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly restoration testing and document results

Control Objective: Ensure system activity is logged and available for review
Current State: Centralized logging is enabled for critical systems
Expected Evidence: SIEM screenshots log source inventory and retention settings

Control Objective: Ensure scheduled financial and system jobs complete successfully
Current State: Scheduled jobs are monitored but exception documentation is inconsistent
Expected Evidence: Job monitoring logs exception tickets and resolution records
Recommended Action: Document failed jobs and remediation actions

Control Objective: Ensure operational incidents affecting financial systems are escalated appropriately
Current State: Incident escalation procedures exist and are generally followed
Expected Evidence: Incident ticket escalation record and resolution documentation
Recommended Action: Continue documenting escalation and resolution activity

Control Objective: Ensure each key ITGC control has an accountable owner
Current State: Most controls have owners but some ownership records are incomplete
Expected Evidence: Control inventory owner assignment and review records
Recommended Action: Assign a documented owner to every key ITGC control
